text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each arm's quantile score (dot) with its 95% interval from re-drawing whole weeks of forecast start. Grey line: R0. Bottom: the six planned contrasts with 99.17% intervals. Grey line at 0: same score. Dashed line, -0.05: the gain the analogues must clear on top of the offset (C4). Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
